title: The Newsroom of True Pages
learning_focus: Informational text; topic, main idea, and supporting details; explanation and news report; author’s purpose; fact, opinion, and fact-based opinion; formal/informal tone; visual and multimedia meaning.
story_premise: Festival reports have been mixed with rumors. The town newsroom cannot publish until the Pathfinder separates evidence from opinion and rebuilds the report.
mission_objective: Complete the three connected areas and apply the mission learning focus: Informational text; topic, main idea, and supporting details; explanation and news report; author’s purpose; fact, opinion, and fact-based opinion; formal/informal tone; visual and multimedia meaning.
